title: B100 RFQs
description: Request neat UCOME B100 and compare supplier declarations against your delivery, fuel and evidence requirements.
pilotNotice: RFQ pilot: requests and quotes do not create a trade or reserve inventory. Agree the final contract and verify fuel and sustainability evidence with your counterparty before any transaction.
adminReadOnly: Administrator view · Requests and quotes are read-only.
loadError: Could not load requests. Select Refresh to try again.
detailError: Could not load this request. Select Refresh to try again.
saveError: The change was not saved. Check the terms, validity and your account permissions, then try again. Refresh to check the current state before resubmitting.
catalogUnavailable: The Singapore UCOME B100 pilot is not available in the current catalog.
empty: No B100 requests yet. Published requests will appear here.
cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? Suppliers will no longer be able to submit or revise quotes.
withdrawConfirm: Withdraw your quote? You can submit a revised quote while the request remains open.
contractVersion: Specification version {{version}} · Neat B100 · 100% UCO feedstock
commercialTerms: Payment, inspection, title and claims terms
missingContract: Structured contract terms are missing. This request cannot receive UCOME quotes.
missingOffer: No structured supplier declaration was supplied.
comparisonNote: Compare offers on the same contract basis. USD/GJ uses each supplier’s declared lower heating value; it does not account for engine efficiency or compliance value.
evidenceNotice: Declared, pending and available describe supplier-provided evidence. None means that Verdaxis has verified the fuel, certificate or claim. A document reference does not upload or verify a document.
chooseRequest: Select a request to inspect its terms.
declaredMatch: Supplier declares that all contract terms are met

form.requestIntro: Set the delivery, fuel and evidence requirements for this request. Complete all fields unless marked optional.
form.minimumFillHint: Must not exceed the requested quantity. This pilot requires quotes for the full quantity.
form.neatFameScope: Neat UCOME B100 with 100% used cooking oil feedstock. The contract specifies the fuel standard, edition and sustainability scheme.
form.editionHint: State the exact edition required for this contract.
form.declarationNotice: These are participant declarations. Verdaxis does not verify fuel quality, sustainability certificates or supporting documents.
form.quoteIntro: Declare the batch and evidence for this quote. Your quote must meet the request terms and cover its full quantity.
form.localTimeHint: Enter your local time. Quote expiry must be on or before the request deadline.
form.ciMethodologyHint: Required when CI is declared. State the calculation basis or supporting document.
form.certificateValidityHint: The declared certificate must remain valid through the delivery end date.
form.documentReferencesHint: One reference per line, up to 20 references of 200 characters each. Required when documents are available. References do not upload documents.
form.confirmTerms: I declare that this offer is neat UCOME B100 from 100% used cooking oil and meets all requested commercial, fuel and evidence terms, including the standard edition and sustainability scheme. I am responsible for the accuracy of this declaration.

validation.requiredFields: Complete all required fields with meaningful text.
validation.deliveryDates: Delivery must start today or later in Singapore time, and end on or after its start date.
validation.minimumFill: Minimum fill must not exceed the requested quantity.
validation.missingContract: This request has no structured contract terms. A UCOME quote cannot be submitted.
validation.quoteExpiry: Quote expiry must be in the future and on or before the request deadline.
validation.availableQuantity: Available quantity must cover the full requested quantity.
validation.cfppLimit: Declare CFPP at or below the requested maximum.
validation.ciLimit: Declare CI at or below the requested maximum.
validation.ciMethodology: State the methodology for the declared CI.
validation.certificateDate: The certificate must remain valid through the delivery end date.
validation.evidenceReferences: Add document references when documents are available.
validation.referenceLength: Use no more than 20 document references, each with no more than 200 characters.
validation.confirmTerms: Confirm that your offer meets all requested terms.
validation.requestExpiry: The request deadline must be on or before the end of the delivery period in Singapore time.

revisionConflict: This quote changed while you were editing. Select Refresh, reopen the quote, and apply your changes to the latest revision.
audience: Buyer identity is hidden from suppliers. Quote details are visible to the requesting buyer, the quoting supplier and authorized administrators.
stateConflict: This request or quote has changed. Select Refresh to load its current state before making another change.
permissionError: Your account cannot perform this action. Confirm that you are using the correct buyer or supplier account and that your organization is approved for the pilot.
missingError: This request or quote is no longer available to your account. Select Refresh to update the list.
rateLimitError: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
closedError: This request is closed or expired. Select Refresh to see its current status.
contractMismatch: The declared standard, edition or sustainability scheme does not match the request. Refresh the request and use its exact requirements.
validationRejected: The request was not saved because some values are invalid. Check required text, numeric limits, delivery dates and quote validity before resubmitting.
